Our Story

15 Saal Ka Bharosa

For over 15 years, Satyam Events has built trust with hundreds of families across Jaipur and Rajasthan. We started with one belief — every family deserves a wedding that feels truly theirs.

  • Complete in-house production — no middlemen, full control
  • Dedicated experienced wedding planning professionals
  • Transparent pricing, detailed budgeting, no hidden costs
  • Personal attention from our core team on every event
  • Trusted by hundreds of families since 2009
